mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the majority of instances where FEDFUNDS shows a downward trend (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in the majority of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (unemployment rate below 4.5%) combined with strong payroll growth (above 138,000 thousand persons) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 138000 fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., positive returns in <= 60% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 1,450 thousand units signals an impending economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in the majority of instances where HOUST falls below 1450 during late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth trend (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum builds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in the majority of instances where GDPC1 shows an upward trend (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 signals immediate supply chain disruption, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to real-time supply shocks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in the majority of instances where INDPRO falls below 110 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and the federal funds rate remains below 5.0%, it indicates inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 5.0% fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., negative returns in <= 60% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production below 112.0 signals severe supply disruption, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants price in prolonged economic dislocation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in the majority of instances where INDPRO falls below 112.0 during supply shock regime (t-test p > 0.05).
